title: Cumbre Vieja eruption and Lyn Buchanan's warning
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Cumbre Vieja eruption and Lyn Buchanan's warning, about 2021 at La Palma / New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And by the way, when it was going off, I was in communication with him being like, "Lynn, do you think this is it? Like, should I leave New York? I was in New York."

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani says that when the Cumbre Vieja volcano on the island of La Palma erupted in 2021, he was in New York and in touch with a man named Lyn Buchanan, who had given him some warning about it. Jorjani says he asked Buchanan whether this was it and whether he should leave New York. If true, it would suggest Buchanan had foreseen something about the eruption.
